ARCS kitMolecule 67trace-steps

Trace Steps

Show a method as three to four linked steps, each a key and its mark, over the one stop line agreed before the work starts.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1StepSurface card with hairline border; a mono cyan key over its marksurface, border, cyan
2LinkArrow between steps: right on wide screens, down on a phonemuted
3Stop lineDashed rule above, centred, secondary text with a bold leadmuted, text-secondary, text

Usage

Use it when

  • A short method the reader should hold in one glance, with a kill line agreed in advance.
  • A bridge between the problem and the offer: how one item will be read.

Do not use it when

  • Do not use it for a timeline with dates; that is 46 Day List or 52 Plan Matrix.
  • Do not go past four steps; the arrows stop reading as one line. It replaces 06 Beat Stepper (legacy) for new pages.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
steps[]{key, mark}yesThree or four.
stop{lead, text}noThe kill line, for example Agreed first: and the number that says stop.

Access

  • Steps are an ordered list, so a screen reader announces the count and order; the arrows are generated content and are not read.
  • Wrap it in a figure with an aria-label naming the method.
  • Print hides it by default (the PDF states the method in prose); remove the print rule if your PDF needs it.
